# Aftergraph

> Infrastructure and open research for verifiable intelligent systems: missions, authority, durable execution, evidence, verification and agentic institutions.

## Key pages

- [aftergraph.org](https://aftergraph.org/): Landing page
- [Launcher](https://aftergraph.org/launch): System launcher / command palette for public Aftergraph destinations
- [Status](https://aftergraph.org/status): Operational public projection (build-time)
- [Community](https://aftergraph.org/community): Discussions, roadmap, RFC intake and contribution routing
- [Organization Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/Aftergraph/discussions): Public deliberation and research review
- [Public roadmap](https://github.com/Aftergraph/.github/blob/main/PUBLIC-ROADMAP.md): Gate-driven public priorities
- [RFC process](https://github.com/Aftergraph/.github/blob/main/RFC-PROCESS.md): Organization-wide proposal lifecycle
- [Knowledge Plane docs](https://docs.aftergraph.org/): Live developer & research portal
- [Knowledge Plane quickstart](https://docs.aftergraph.org/developers/quickstart/): Verify the plane in 10 minutes
- [Knowledge Plane Contract Explorer](https://docs.aftergraph.org/standards/contracts/): Canonical cross-repo contract explorer
- [Knowledge Plane Evidence](https://docs.aftergraph.org/evidence/claim-graph/): Claim graph with provenance and audit status
- [Knowledge Plane Sentinel](https://docs.aftergraph.org/sentinel/): Sentinel documentation
- [Health](https://aftergraph.org/healthz): Deployment status
- [Sentinel](https://aftergraph.org/sentinel): Verified code-review product page

## Platform topology (from Aftergraph/after-graph-governance)

Canonical platform topology: 21 repositories
Public repositories: 12
Private repositories: 9

Repository count is a Governance projection, not product identity and not compatibility evidence.

### Public

- `.github`
- `after-graph-governance`
- `aftergraph.org`
- `aie`
- `brand`
- `docs`
- `intelligence-systems-research`
- `sentinel`
- `studio`
- `trust-gateway`
- `wi-backend`
- `works-execution`

### Private

9 private repositories participate in the canonical topology; their repository names are not enumerated on this public allowlist. Public product/capability pages may describe a private implementation without exposing a private source link.

## Product identities

- Studio by Aftergraph
- Sentinel by Aftergraph
- Wie by Aftergraph
- Continuum by Aftergraph

Wie's canonical public backend repository is `wi-backend`. Public product naming is separate from source-repository identity.

## Organization

- GitHub organization: [github.com/Aftergraph](https://github.com/Aftergraph)
- Public repository allowlist: `.github`, `after-graph-governance`, `aftergraph.org`, `aie`, `brand`, `docs`, `intelligence-systems-research`, `sentinel`, `studio`, `trust-gateway`, `wi-backend`, `works-execution`

## Evidence rule

Visibility never upgrades evidence. Canonical topology membership does not establish functional conformance, production readiness or APC compatibility. Research claims, experiments, prototypes and production capabilities are labelled by maturity on their owning surfaces. Research evidence is never runtime authority by itself.
